title: Picrorhiza scrophulariiflora ethanol extract ameliorates CCl(4)-induced acute liver injury by blocking the TSP1/TNF/NF-kappaB axis.
authors: Li, Menghao; Ren, Fengming; Li, Tao; Li, Qiongyuan; He, Lifen; Li, Xuegang; Ye, Xiaoli; Ma, Hang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物提取物对急性肝损伤的保护作用及TSP1/TNF/NF-kappaB通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate the effects and potential mechanisms of Picrorhiza scrophulariiflora ethanol extract (PSE) in ameliorating carbon tetrachloride (CCl(4))-induced acute liver injury. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Mouse models of CCl(4)-induced acute liver injury and HepG2 cell models were established to assess the pharmacodynamic effects of PSE. The viability of HepG2 cells treated with PSE and CCl(4) was determined using CCK-8 assays. H&E staining, liver index, and serum liver function markers were analyzed to evaluate the protective effect of PSE. The levels of superoxide dismutase (SOD), malondialdehyde (MDA), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), and interleukin-6 (IL-6) were assessed both in vivo and in vitro. Using transcriptomics, we identified key pathways and potential target of PSE. To validate the efficacy of these targets within relevant pathways, we conducted cellular thermal shift assays (CETSA), molecular docking, Western blotting, and quantitative real-time PCR analyses. RESULTS: Compared with the model group, PSE treatment significantly increased the survival rate of HepG2 cells. PSE markedly improved the general condition of mice, including reduced liver index, decreased levels of alanine aminotransferase (ALT) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST), and ameliorated histopathological damage in liver tissues. Furthermore, PSE significantly increased SOD activity while reducing MDA levels both in vivo and in vitro. Transcriptomics and cellular thermal shift assays indicated that the effects of PSE were mediated through the TSP1/TNF/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. In addition, PSE treatment decreased both the protein and mRNA levels of NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. CONCLUSION: PSE exerts anti-inflammatory effects via the TSP1/TNF/NF-kappaB axis, thereby ameliorating CCl(4)-induced acute liver injury.
abstract_zh: 研究目的：本研究旨在探讨胡黄连乙醇提取物（PSE）对四氯化碳（CCl(4)）诱导的急性肝损伤的改善作用及其潜在机制。材料与方法：建立CCl(4)诱导的小鼠急性肝损伤模型和HepG2细胞模型，以评估PSE的药效作用。采用CCK-8法测定经PSE和CCl(4)处理的HepG2细胞活力。通过H&E染色、肝脏指数和血清肝功能标志物分析，评估PSE的保护作用。在体内和体外实验中，检测超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）、丙二醛（MDA）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6）的水平。利用转录组学，我们鉴定了PSE的关键通路和潜在靶点。为验证这些靶点在相关通路中的有效性，我们进行了细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、分子对接、Western blotting和定量实时PCR分析。结果：与模型组相比，PSE处理显著提高了HepG2细胞的存活率。PSE显著改善了小鼠的一般状况，包括降低肝脏指数、降低丙氨酸氨基转移酶（ALT）和天冬氨酸氨基转移酶（AST）水平，并改善肝组织的组织病理学损伤。此外，PSE在体内和体外均显著增加SOD活性，同时降低MDA水平。转录组学和细胞热位移分析表明，PSE的作用通过TSP1/TNF/NF-κB信号通路介导。此外，PSE处理降低了NF-κB、TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β的蛋白和mRNA水平。结论：PSE通过TSP1/TNF/NF-κB轴发挥抗炎作用，从而改善CCl(4)诱导的急性肝损伤。
